Package com.example.space.essentials

Class Body

java.lang.Object
com.example.space.essentials.Body
public class Body extends Object
Represents a physical body in the simulation, characterized by its mass, position, velocity, acceleration, and radius.

Each body is influenced by gravity and can be copied or analyzed for its kinematic properties such as speed and acceleration.
